LanguageData.MAP_WheelOfFate.Settings.InitialTheme.La: Lock the starting story theme to Simulation beginning
LanguageData.MAP_WheelOfFate.Settings.InitialTheme.De: When enabled, the Wheel of Fate will prioritize the "Simulation beginning" story theme at the start of the game. This is a relaxed starting theme.
Story themes available for automatic selection
Unchecked story themes have their selection weight reduced to 0 and will not be selected naturally.
This theme has a default rotation weight of 0 and does not participate in rotation.
LanguageData.MAP_WheelOfFate.Settings.Details.Label: Show detailed descriptions of Wheel of Fate story themes
LanguageData.MAP_WheelOfFate.Settings.Details.Descrip: When enabled, display the theme type when the story theme changes.

LanguageData.MAP_WheelOfFate.ThemeChanged.HiddenText: The Wheel of Fate has begun a new simulation. What awaits us next?
LanguageData.MAP_WheelOfFate.Settings.ResetTheme: Reset this theme's settings to defaults
LanguageData.MAP_WheelOfFate.Settings.IncidentInterva: Adjusts the average interval between random events generated by the storyteller. Lower values make events occur more frequently.
LanguageData.MAP_WheelOfFate.Settings.EnemyWeight: Permanently hostile raid faction weight multiplier
LanguageData.MAP_WheelOfFate.Settings.EqualWeightsHin: This theme uses equal-weight selection, so individual event weight multipliers do not affect these selections.
LanguageData.MAP_WheelOfFate.Settings.InvertedWeights: This theme uses inverse-weight selection. Higher weights here make candidates less likely to be selected.
